deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (Round 1) for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Chemistry, Psychology, Molecular and Cell Biology, Neuroscience, Biochemistry and Biophysics | December 1

gre_general.value: Submission of GRE scores is optional per Brandeis Graduate Admissions PhD requirements (old MCB apply-phd URL now redirects).
gre_general.quote: GRE (Optional) | Submission of GRE scores is entirely optional.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for biology; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Faculty members cannot accept students directly into labs before admission; all MCB PhD students complete four rotations in year 1 before choosing a dissertation lab.
supervisor.quote: Faculty members cannot accept graduate students directly into their labs prior to acceptance into the program. All MCB PhD students must complete four research rotations in their first year before choosing a dissertation lab.

funding.value: All MCB PhD students are guaranteed funding, including a fellowship, full tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students are guaranteed funding, including a competitive fellowship, a full-tuition scholarship, and health insurance benefits.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree to apply.
entry_route.quote: You must hold (or be about to earn) a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. or international institution.

notes: The MCB page sets no numeric TOEFL or IELTS minimum, so the university values apply.
